target: 576 Palatium

source: 576 Palace
target: 576 Palatium

source: Having transformed into Simon through a Seer pathway’s Sealed Artifact, Lato Guiaro observed the illusory starlight surrounding them, akin to seawater caught in a vortex.
target: Mutatus in Simon per rem sigillatam itineris vatis, Lato Guiaro stellam illusoriam quae circum eos fulgebat contemplatus est, instar aquae maris in vortice capta.

source: It cascaded down, forming a massive funnel.
target: Cascavit deorsum, ingentem infundibulum formans.

source: The origin of this vortex was the humanoid Sealed Artifact they had “abducted” from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church!
target: Origo huius vortici fuit artifactum sigillatum humanoideo, quod ex Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Ardoris rapuerant!

source: After the exposure of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society’s internal affairs and the consecutive deaths of Loki and I Know Someone, one resurrected at the cost of a precious opportunity, while the other met a permanent end.
target: Post expositionem rerum internarum Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crisporum et mortibus consecutivis Loki et I Know Someone, unus resurrexit, pretiosa occasione impensa, alter vero in finem perpetuum incidit.

source: They adjusted their initial sea sacrifice plan and activated a backup strategy to counter potential interference from the Research Society.
target: Consilium primum sacrificii maritimi accommodaverunt et stratagemata subsidiaria activaverunt ad subtrahendam interpositionem potentialem ab illa Societate.

source: According to the revived Loki’s warning, Hela, the society’s vice president, had likely ascended to Sequence 4, reaching demigod status, and switched from the Death pathway to the Evernight pathway.
target: Secundum monitionem Loki revivificati, Hela, vice praesidis societatis, verisimiliter ad Ordinem IV ascenderat, statum semideus adeptans, et ab itinere mortis in viam noctis aeternae transiit.

source: Depending solely on Ultraman, Bard, and Mad Lady, their intricate plans would crumble before absolute strength.
target: Confisi solum in Ultraman, Bard et Mad Lady, consilia eorum intricata ante vim absolutam corruerent.

source: Of course, they were confident if it were just Hela alone.
target: Scilicet, fiduciam habebant, si sola Hela aderat.

source: Confidence wavered when considering President Gandalf, an enigma, and the other vice presidents, alongside the troublesome society members.
target: Fides labefactata est, cum considerabant Praesidem Gandalf, enigmam, et ceteros vice praesides, una cum incommodis sodalibus societatatis.

source: Dealing with them now seemed an insurmountable challenge.
target: Aggredi eos nunc videbatur pro provocatione insuperabili.

source: Starlight surged, revealing a sorrowful woman in black nun’s attire to everyone on the ship.
target: Lux stellarum exsultavit, revelans mulierem lugubrem in veste monialis nigrae omnibus in nave.

source: Her presence felt magnetic, as if attempting to absorb everything around her.
target: Praesentia eius velut magnetica videbatur, quasi omnia circa ipsa attrahens.

source: It was akin to an unusually heavy iron ball falling from the center of a taut fishing net, dragging objects down and pulling the surrounding net with it.
target: Hoc simile erat pila ferrea insolita gravitate, e centro rete piscatorio tenso cadens, obiecta trahens et rete circumjacentem secum arrigens.

source: In these circumstances, previously still items naturally slipped away.
target: In his condicionibus, prius immobilia elementa naturaliter labebant.

source: The most impacted was Juan Oro, with a potent sea bloodline and formidable sea power.
target: Maxime affectus est Juan Oro, qui potentem sanguinis maritimi consanguinitatem et formidabilem vim maris habuit.

source: Resisting the sea’s fury, he felt a spatial inversion, as if his front and back had switched to up and down.
target: Resistens iram maris, sensit inversionem spatii, ac si partes frontales et dorsales eius in sursum atque deorsum commutatae essent.

source: Like a lost person above an abyss, he involuntarily “fell” to the bottom at an accelerated speed, where the woman in black nun’s attire awaited.
target: Sicut vagus super abyssum, ineluctabiliter ad imum celeriter cecidit, ubi mulier in veste monialis nigrae exspectabat.

source: The deputy hosts, apart from Lumian, felt an unseen force tugging at them.
target: Praefecti vicarii, praeter Lumian, senserunt vim invisibilem eos trahentem.

source: Struggling, they staggered towards the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
target: Titubantes, ad artifactum sigillatum humanoideum contendebant.

source: The sea’s power within them wavered, propelling them to the surface, revealing sparkling starry scales that hinted at losing control.
target: Vis maris in illis vacillabat, eos ad superficiem impellens, et squamas micantes instar stellarum revelabat, quae imperium amittere insinuabant.

source: The Maidens of the Sea and the sailors on the ship struggled against the terrifying suction force, swaying on the spot.
target: Mulieres maritimae et nautae in nave certabant adversus vim sugentem terribilem, in loco titubantes.

source: Some experienced their skin smoothing, others felt scales emerging in their flesh, and a few shifted their feet intermittently.
target: Nonnulli sensitērunt cutem suam leniorem fieri, alii squamas in carne emergere, et pauci pedes intermittenter commutatos esse.

source: Lumian, though relatively unscathed, exerted considerable strength to resist the relentless pull.
target: Lumian, quamquam relative intactus, vim ingentem ad repellendum trahendi inexorabilem adhibuit.

source: As an Ascetic, he vaguely sensed the river of fate for everyone present surging toward the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
target: Ut asceticus, vage sensit flumen fati omnium praesentium ad artifactum sigillatum humanoideum impellere.

source: Future tributaries narrowed and converged, leading inevitably to one possibility—death.
target: Futuri affluentes coarctati et convenientes, ad unum exitum inevitabilem—mortem—ducebant.

source: In that moment, Lumian grasped why the humanoid Sealed Artifact could use words to curse someone to death.
target: In illo momento, Lumian intellexit cur artifactum sigillatum humanoideo verbis uti posset ad maledicendum aliquem morti.

source: Lato Guiaro reached out, gripping the shipboard to resist the invisible pull from the woman.
target: Lato Guiaro manum extendit, praeam navis tenens, ad repellendam vim invisibilem ab illa muliere.

source: His gaze scanned the people on the ship, then returned to the sea’s depths.
target: Oculi eius homines in nave perinspecti sunt, deinde in profundos maris revertit.

source: The ship descended, surrounded by a translucent wall of azure seawater.
target: Navis descendebat, circumdata muri translucidis aquae maris caeruleae.

source: Sea creatures swam within, seemingly oblivious to the anomaly.
target: Creaturae maritimae intus natabant, quasi insensibiles anomaliae essent.

source: In the distance, the spindle-shaped silver-gray object at the sea bottom, its tip embedded in rocks, came into view.
target: In longinquo, obiectum fusiforme argenteo-cinereum in fundo maris, cuius acies in saxis insita erat, conspectum factum est.

source: Lato Guiaro suppressed any sign of a smile.
target: Lato Guiaro omne indicium risus repressit.

source: He was nearing his destination.
target: Propinabat metae suae.

source: The fools from the Fisheries Guild and the oblivious Earth Mother Church might never comprehend what lay sealed at the bottom of the sea here.
target: Stulti ex Gildā Piscatoria et Ecclesia Matris Terrae inscius numquam intellexerent quid hic in fundo maris sigillatum iaceretur.

source: It wasn’t a so-called “palace” but a spaceship!
target: Non erat quod vocaretur “palatium”, sed navis spatialis!

source: A spacecraft that infiltrated during the Fourth Epoch!
target: Navis spatialis, quae Aetate Quarta intravit!

source: It boasted a sci‑fi dimension, housing advanced technology entwined with mystical Beyonder elements, forming the core of the entire spaceship.
target: Ea gloriabatur in dimensione scientiae fictilis, technologia provecta habens cum elementis mysticis Beyonder contextis, quae cor totius astronavis constituebant.

source: A locator, a petri dish, a breeding box, a key component of a Stargate—a place where a Beyonder object slumbered.
target: Invenitor, vas petrii, arca generandi, pars clavis stargati—locus ubi obiectum Beyonder quiescebat.

source: The Ring of the Sea Queen, crafted by the sea spawn, served as the spacecraft’s key.
target: Anulus Reginae Maris, a prole maris confectus, clavis astronavis fuit.

source: Only when the external seal weakened annually could it activate the spacecraft’s internal power, merging the two to crack the core seal!
target: Tantum cum sigillum externum per annum infirmaretur, poterat vim internam astronavis excitare, miscens ambos ut sigillum nuclei rumpat!

source: Lato Guiaro’s gaze grew greedier as he stared at the faintly discernible silver‑gray behemoth.
target: Aspectus Lato Guiaro avidior factus est, dum ingentem argenteo‑cinereum vix perceptibilem considerabat.

source: His aim extended beyond temporary authority—to become the true Governor of the Sea and the spaceship’s owner.
target: Propositum eius ultra auctoritatem temporariam protendebat—fieri verus Gubernator Maris et dominus astronavis.

source: This would grant him immense power and the ability to accomplish unimaginable feats using the spaceship.
target: Hoc ei daret ingentem potentiam atque facultatem ad res inauditas per astronavis exsequendas.

source: The azure sea, tinged with a hint of green, encircled the ship as if respectfully escorting them into the palace of the sea.
target: Mare caeruleum, leviter viridum, navem circumiaciebat, tamquam reverenter eos in palatium maris ducebat.

source: Seeing the sea’s fury interrupted by the woman’s sudden appearance, making her the most perilous element, Juan Oro wasted no time deepening his connection with the sea.
target: Videns furiam maris, interruptam per repentinam adventum mulieris, quae eam partem periculosissimam reddidit, Juan Oro nullo tempore cessavit ad coniunctionem cum mari augendam.

source: At that moment, he temporarily became the Governor of the Sea.
target: In eo momento, ad tempus, factus est Gubernator Maris.

source: He resisted the terrifying suction force.
target: Repugnavit vim sugentem terribilem.

source: Abruptly, the humanoid Sealed Artifact “departed” from the ship, entering an empty darkness.
target: Subito, artifactum sigillatum humanoideo a nave discessit, in tenebras vacuas ingrediens.

source: Resplendent stars flickered above, below, and to her left.
target: Stellae resplendentes scintillabant supra, infra, atque ad sinistram eius.

source: Ahead stood Juan Oro, covered in starlight scales, deep-eyed, and with completely white hair.
target: Ante stabat Juan Oro, opertus squamis stellarum micantibus, oculis profundis, et capillis omnino albis.

source: Juan Oro raised his right hand, swiping his finger.
target: Juan Oro dextram manum erexit, digito submurmurans.

source: The “stars” plummeted with fiery tails, stirring up waves.
target: Stellae ceciderunt cum caudis ardentibus, undas excitantes.

source: On the betrothal ship, everyone lost the momentum to rush to the same place.
target: In nave nuptiali, omnes impetus ad eundem locum properandi amiserunt.

source: However, the power they used to resist the pull couldn’t be withdrawn, causing them to fall in the opposite direction.
target: Tamen vis, qua repugnaverunt attrahenti, revocari non potuit, quod faceret eos in contrariam directionem cadere.

source: Lato Guiaro feigned a similar state, crashing into the bow of the ship.
target: Lato Guiaro statum simile simulavit, in proram navis impingens.

source: Seeing the silver‑gray behemoth approaching, his heart leaped with joy.
target: Cum ingentem argenteo‑cinereum appropinquantem vidit, cor eius gaudio exsultavit.

source: He was about to recite a phrase he didn’t comprehend but understood its purpose.
target: Paratus erat verba recitandi, quae non penitus intellexit, sed propositum eorum scivit.

source: It was a coded order to completely open the spaceship’s door and establish an energy passageway, allowing him to enter under protection!
target: Illa erat mandatum codificatum ad plene aperiendum ostium astronavis et ad viam energeticae transitus instituendam, ut ei sub tutela intrandi liceret!

source: April Fool’s had been established for several years.
target: Dies Aprilis Stultorum per plures annos institutus erat.

source: Lato Guiaro’s decision to target the sea prayer ritual last year was influenced by the resolution of other voices from the Governor of the Sea, Maidens of the Sea, and certain sea spawn.
target: Decisio Lato Guiaro, anno ultimo ad rituum precationem maritimam intendendum, evenit ex resolutione aliorum vocum a Gubernatore Maris, Virginibus Maris, et quibusdam prole maris.

source: This allowed them to understand the significance of the three crucial passages.
target: Hoc eos adiit ut significationem trium viis maximi momenti comprehendere possent.

source: “I espouse thee, O sea…” was one of the passages, its true meaning being to inject energy into the created key and enter a password.
target: “I espouse thee, O sea…” erat una ex viis, cuius verus sensus erat energiam in clavem creatae infundere atque tesserae ingredi.

source: Lato Guiaro was about to recite the second paragraph, which served as an order to initiate the spaceship.
target: Lato Guiaro parabat se secundum paragraphum recitare, quod ut ordo ad astronavis inchoandum valeret.

source: Initially, he and Bard planned to deceive the foolish Nolfi, tricking her into reciting the words to avoid danger.
target: Primum, ipse et Bard constituerunt Nolfi stulte fallere, eam convincendo verba recitare ne periculum incideret.

source: Once the spaceship activated and left these waters, the sea prayer ritual would naturally conclude.
target: Cum astronavis activatus est et has aquas reliquit, ritualis precationis maritimae naturaliter finem habebunt.

source: There wouldn’t be any follow-up.
target: Nulla postactio sequeretur.

source: Whether it involved self‑destruction or not, it wasn’t a concern for her; she had achieved her essential goal.
target: Sive in auto‑destructionem incidat, illa non curabat; propositum eius principale perfecit.

source: However, the situation changed drastically, especially when the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society learned about the sea prayer ritual.
target: Attamen res fundamentaliter mutatae sunt, praesertim cum Societas Investigationis Papionum Crisporum de ritu precationis maritimae novit.

source: Ultraman and Bard modified their plans, roping in external aid and reducing Nolfi’s role.
target: Ultraman et Bard consilia sua mutaverunt, auxilium externe adligantes et partem Nolfi minuentes.

source: Eventually, she became bait to lead troublemakers, represented by Lumian Lee and Hidden Blade.
target: Postremo, illa facta est esca ad ducendos tumultuosos, qui a Lumian Lee et Hidden Blade repraesentabantur.

source: Lato Guiaro opened his mouth and muttered the words.
target: Lato Guiaro os aperuit et verba submurmuravit.

source: As he finished speaking, he looked expectantly at the spaceship at the sea bottom.
target: Cum sermonem absolvit, expectanter ad astronavis in fundo maris intuitus est.

source: But nothing happened!
target: Sed nihil evenit!

source: How is this possible?
target: Quomodo hoc fieri potest?

source: Lato Guiaro’s heart tightened, feeling a sudden sense of danger.
target: Cor Lato Guiaro contraxit, subitum periculi sensum experiens.

source: With a jolt, he saw everything disintegrate like a soap bubble, vanishing.
target: Cum ictu, omnia vidit quasi bulla saponaria evanescere.

source: Lumian, transformed into Brian, had arrived near him at some point.
target: Lumian, in Brian transfiguratus, prope eum advenerat.

source: A dream!
target: Somnium!

source: He had been dreaming since Juan Oro pulled the humanoid Sealed Artifact into the Cosmic Void!
target: Somniabat ex quo Juan Oro artifactum sigillatum humanoideo in Vacuum Cosmicum traxit.

source: Hela! This name flashed through Lato Guiaro’s mind.
target: Hela! Hoc nomen per mentem Lato Guiaro scintillavit.

source: He had paid attention to whether there were other ships lurking around!
target: Attentus erat num aliae naves latent.

source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, formless hands appeared around Lato Guiaro, pushing Lumian away.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius trahebantur, manus informae circa Lato Guiaro apparuerunt, Lumian repellentes.

source: Then, he saw a sailboat, clearly abandoned by time, outlined in the cavity surrounded by seawater beside the betrothal ship.
target: Tum, vidit naviculam velariam, manifeste tempore relictam, in cavitate circumdata aquā maritima iuxta navem nuptialem delineatam.

source: Shadows clung to its canvas, and corpses stood on the observatory.
target: Umbrae ad velum eius adhaerebant, et cadavera in speculatorio stabant.

source: The deck was littered with decaying or boneless undead creatures.
target: Pavimentum navis erat congestum creaturis putrīdīs aut ossibus carentibus, quasi mortuīs.

source: At the bow of the ship, a woman dressed as a black widow stood silently.
target: In prora navis, mulier, veste viduae nigrae induta, tacite stabat.

source: Hela!
target: Hela!

source: Less than four hours ago, Franca, posing as Charname, signaled Nolfi and Batna to wait for further arrangements.
target: Ante minus quam quattuor horās, Franca, se ut Charname praebens, Nolfi et Batna signum dedit ut ulteriores dispositiones exspectarent.

source: Returning to the cabin, she entered the captain’s cabin and addressed Hela, standing by the window.
target: Rediens ad cubicula, intravit cubiculam capitānī et ad Hela, iuxta fēnestram stantem, locuta est.

source: “I’ve roughly guessed who Ultraman is, but I can’t be sure.”
target: “Fere coniexi quis sit Ultraman, sed certus esse non possum.”

source: “I guessed as much,” Hela replied, having overheard Franca and Nolfi’s conversation.
target: “Sic coniexi,” respondit Hela, cum sermonem Francae et Nolfi auscultasset.

source: Franca gritted her teeth and said, “If it’s really Lato Guiaro, there will definitely be variables on the ship. I have to quickly summon Lumian’s messenger and inform him of our guess.”
target: Franca dentes contrāxit et dixit: “Si vere Lato Guiaro sit, pro certo varia erunt in nave. Celeriter nuntiarium Lumiani convocandum est atque eum de nostrīs coniectūrīs certiōrem facere debeo.”

source: “Let’s wait a little longer and time it well. We’ll send the message when the deputy hosts leave the Governor of the Sea’s residence but prior to boarding the ship,” Hela advised.
target: “Exspectemus paulo diutius et tempus bene disponāmus. Nuntiarium mittāmus cum hospitēs vicarii domum Gubernatōris Maris relinquant, sed ante navem conscendendum,” monet Hela.

source: Franca confirmed succinctly, “Got it.”
target: Franca breviter confirmāvit: “Intellectum.”

source: She observed Hela, with her light‑blond hair naturally cascading over her shoulders, and her dark eyes seemingly darker as she meticulously engraved patterns and arranged items on the captain’s cabin desk.
target: Illam spectāvit, Hela, cuius capillī flavī naturaliter super umeros decurrunt, et oculī obscuriārēs videbantur dum diligenter figuras incidebat et res in mensā cubiculī capitānī ordinābat.

source: With curiosity, she promptly inquired, “What’s this for?”
target: Cum curiōsitāte, statim quaesivit: “Ad quid hoc?”

source: “Setting up a ritual to completely conceal the entire ship, preventing anyone from discovering it. It’s impossible for me to do this on my own. I can only achieve it through a deity’s help. And She should be very willing to help.”
target: “Instituendo ritu ad totam navem omnīnō tegendam, ut nemo eam detegat. Mihi sōlī hoc efficere īmpossībilis est. Tantum per auxilium deitātis hoc assequi possum, et Ea valde lībēns adiuvāre dēbet.”

source: Without hesitation, Hela took off the pure silver ring embedded with a black diamond from her right hand and placed it in the center of the altar.
target: Sine dubitātiōne, Hela annulum pūrum argenteum, in quo adamantum nigrum infixum erat, de manu dēstrā abstulit et in medium altāris posuit.

source: On the betrothal ship, Lumian scrutinized Lato Guiaro, his body quivering with excitement.
target: In nave nuptiali, Lumian Lato Guiaro inspectāvit, corpus eius exsultātiōne tremens.

source: He couldn’t comprehend how the other party had thwarted the sea prayer ritual once again.
target: Non potuit intellegere quōmodo altera pars ritu precationis maritimae iterum impedīret.

source: After all, he had been vigilantly observing this “old friend” of his and hadn’t witnessed any ring‑switching.
target: Nam ille hunc “amicum senem” eius diligenter observaverat et nullam permutationem annulī conspectus habebat.

source: Nonetheless, it didn’t matter.
target: Tamen, nihil refert.

source: A well‑devised plan was not a fragile creation that crumbled with the slightest mistake.
target: Consilium bene ordinatum non erat fragilis creatiō, quā minimo errō corrueret.

source: It had to allow for enough margin for error!
target: Satis locum ad errōs tolerandō conferebat!

source: Similarly, Lato Guiaro couldn’t fathom how Hela and the ship had approached without triggering his detection.
target: Similiter, Lato Guiaro non potuit comprehendere quōmodo Hela et navis accesserint sine actu detegendi.

source: But it didn’t matter.
target: Sed nihil tamen refert.

source: If they hadn’t prepared for the interference of the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society and Hela, they wouldn’t have taken action this time.
target: Si parati non fuerunt ad obstructionem a Societāte Investigationis Papionum Crisporum et Hela, hoc tempore agere non potuerunt.

source: Lato Guiaro’s eyes suddenly darkened, and specks of starlight illuminated.
target: Oculī Lato Guiaro subito tenebrosi factī sunt, et micellae lucis stellarum relucuere.

source: The surrounding azure seawater froze once more.
target: Aqua maritima caerulea circumdatā iterum congela est.

source: Here, he surpassed the old‑timer, Juan Oro.
target: Hīc superavit senem, Juan Oro.

source: He had long amassed the power to temporarily become the Governor of the Sea!
target: Iamdiū potentiam congregaverat ad temporāriē Gubernatōrem Maris efficiendum!

source: In the upcoming period, he would ascend to become the god of these waters!
target: In temporibus futūris, ascendisset ut dēus harum aquārum fieret.
